method: Independent original AS3 functions, separate from actual original runtime

results.scope: Private unchanged original wave/Remake/GenerateNew/Bessel functions with type annotations removed, original SHA256 checked. Every native scalar increment independently at other defaults and all min/max cross-product corners, every original grid sample at five bounded timeline steps. The original random initial mode/wavelength is made explicit in native controls/defaults; no arbitrary random histories or complete multi-input Cartesian product claim. Native contours/styles and responsive camera presentation are new UI.
